FX-LWIPE-001.says: The settings as they start, completion 0, angle 90, feather 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-LWIPE-002.says: Completion 25: the edge is a quarter of the way across from the left, at x = 4, so columns 0 to 3 are gone, all four channels 0, and columns 4 to 15 are the drawing's own, exactly.

FX-LWIPE-003.says: Completion 50: the left half, columns 0 to 7, is gone; the right half is untouched.

FX-LWIPE-004.says: Completion 100: every pixel is transparent, the soft edges too.

FX-LWIPE-005.says: Completion 50, feather 4: the edge is soft over four pixels round x = 8; columns 0 to 5 are gone, columns 6, 7, 8 and 9 keep 1/8, 3/8, 5/8 and 7/8 of every channel, and columns 10 to 15 are untouched.

FX-LWIPE-006.says: Angle 270, completion 25: the wipe comes from the right, the edge at x = 12; columns 12 to 15 are gone, the soft skin edge with them.

FX-LWIPE-007.says: Angle 0, completion 30: the edge moves up, so the wipe comes from the bottom, the edge at y = 7; rows 7 to 9 are gone.

FX-LWIPE-008.says: Angle 180, completion 30: the edge moves down, so the wipe comes from the top, the edge at y = 3; rows 0 to 2 are gone.

FX-LWIPE-009.says: Angle 45, completion 40: the wipe comes from the bottom left corner towards the top right along a diagonal; a pixel stays whole where x - y is at least 1 and is gone otherwise, the bottom left triangle wiped.

FX-LWIPE-010.says: Angle 135, completion 50, feather 6: from the top left corner, with a soft diagonal edge; the top left is gone, the bottom right untouched, and between them each pixel keeps a part that grows towards the bottom right.

FX-LWIPE-011.says: Angle 450, a whole turn past 90, completion 25: exactly FX-LWIPE-002.

FX-LWIPE-012.says: Angle -270, completion 25: -270 is 90 the other way round, exactly FX-LWIPE-002.

FX-LWIPE-013.says: Completion 50, feather 10000, the most: the edge is so soft that every pixel keeps about half of itself, from 0.49925 of it at the left to 0.50075 at the right.

FX-LWIPE-014.says: Completion 0 with angle 45 and feather 20: completion 0 changes nothing, whatever the other settings.

FX-LWIPE-015.says: Completion keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 1 is FX-LWIPE-002, frame 2 FX-LWIPE-003, frame 3 columns 0 to 11 gone, and frame 4 FX-LWIPE-004; the edge sweeps left to right.

FX-LWIPE-016.says: Completion held at 25 from frame 0, then 50 from frame 3: frames 0 and 2 are FX-LWIPE-002, frames 3 and 4 FX-LWIPE-003.

FX-LWIPE-017.says: Completion eased from 50 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it has gone past 100 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 are both FX-LWIPE-004, every pixel transparent.

FX-LWIPE-018.says: Angle keyed from 90 at frame 0 to 270 at frame 4, linear, completion 30: the edge turns round, from the left (columns 0 to 4 gone) through the top left, the top at frame 2 (FX-LWIPE-008) and the top right, to the right at frame 4 (columns 11 to 15 gone).

FX-LWIPE-019.says: Feather keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, linear, completion 50: frame 0 is FX-LWIPE-003, frame 2 FX-LWIPE-005, and frame 4 soft over eight pixels, columns 4 to 11.

FX-LWIPE-020.says: FX-LWIPE-002 on the layer moved three pixels right: the edge is the drawing's own and moves with it, so the drawing's columns 0 to 3, now 3 to 6, are gone.

FX-LWIPE-021.says: A drop shadow two pixels left, the layer moved three pixels right, completion 0: the drawing with its shadow, untouched, the shadow's two columns out past the drawing's left edge in columns 1 and 2 too.

FX-LWIPE-022.says: The same with completion 1: the edge is at x = 0.16, just inside the drawing's left edge, so the drawing is whole but the shadow's grown columns, left of the edge at x = -1.5 and -0.5, are gone.

FX-LWIPE-023.says: The same with angle 270 and completion 99: the wipe from the right has reached x = -0.16, so all of the drawing is gone but the shadow's grown columns, beyond the edge, stay.

FX-LWIPE-024.says: The same with completion 100: every pixel is transparent, the shadow's grown columns too.

FX-LWIPE-025.says: Completion -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LWIPE-026.says: Completion 100.5, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LWIPE-027.says: Angle 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LWIPE-028.says: Angle -3601, below -3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LWIPE-029.says: Feather -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LWIPE-030.says: Feather 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LWIPE-031.says: Completion keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LWIPE-032.says: Completion written "50", a word, not a number. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
